intake.title: Intake
intake.intro: Buy singles from a seller: scan their cards, check the matches, then tap Complete to see the cash and trade offers.
intake.noLocation: No intake location is set, so you can quote but not buy. An administrator can choose one in Administration ▸ Intake.

scan.completeHint: Confirm each match (or correct it), then tap Complete for the quote. Nothing is added until you buy.

quote.noCards: No cards to quote. Go back and scan some.
quote.needsPrices: Some cards have no price. Enter one, or leave the card out.
quote.noBuyPermission: You can quote, but buying needs the Intake ▸ Buy cards permission.

buy.title: Buy {{count}} card
buy.customerRequired: Store credit goes on a customer's account — choose or add the customer.
buy.pricesChanged: Prices changed since the quote was shown. Check the new totals, then buy again.
buy.done: Bought {{count}} card for {{cash}} cash and {{trade}} store credit.
buy.done_other: Bought {{count}} cards for {{cash}} cash and {{trade}} store credit.

historyPage.title: Intake history
historyPage.intro: Every buy: who took the cards in, from whom, and what was paid.

settings.title: Intake
settings.intro: How cards bought over the counter are priced. Offers are a percentage of the card's market (or low) price, adjusted for condition, and always round down.
settings.samePercentHint: With the same percentage for both, sellers see one offer.
settings.conditionsHelp: Percent of the price paid for each condition.
settings.bulkThresholdHelp: Cards worth less than this (after condition) count as bulk. 0 turns bulk off.
settings.locationHelp: Bought cards are added here. Staff who buy need write access to its site.
settings.customerViewHelp: What the seller sees when you hand them the phone. The offer totals always show.
